plugin.name: workspace-wallpaper
plugin._long: Renders a wallpaper quad per workspace cell as scene content, so expo shows unique wallpapers.

option.name: pattern
option._long: Base filename pattern with {x} and {y} placeholders, extension auto-detected.

option.name: manifest
option._long: Optional path to a coordinate map. Each non-comment line is "x y path"; path is absolute, ~-relative, or relative to directory. Entries here override the directory/pattern probe. A line "x y OUTPUT /abs/slice" is a pre-cut slice: on that output, that workspace shows the image over the whole output as cut, and the plain "x y path" line is the fallback for every other output. A line is a slice when its third field holds no '/' and the rest is an absolute or ~/ path.
